caseName: Herrin Transportation Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Herrin Transportation Co., Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Robert A. Ainsworth, Jr. for appellants., Acting Solicitor General Stern and Edward M. Reidy for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission; and Allan Watkins for the Atlanta-New Orleans Motor Freight Co. et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set down for argument.
